title: ericameria filifolia
intro: Ericameria filifolia, commonly known as Bigelow's goldenrod or Bigelow's woolly-head, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is a shrubby perennial plant belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). The health benefits of Ericameria filifolia include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can be beneficial for wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral effects.
